question: Who may be initiated using a mantra understood as a name-mantra?
premises: The mantra is recognized as a nāmamantra.
Initiation is permitted in this case.
inference: Knowing it as a name-mantra, one may initiate even caṇḍālas.
plain_english: Knowing it to be a name-mantra, one should initiate even caṇḍālas.
